10.1002/pola.70298.title: Structure-Conformation-Reactivity Relationships in Optically Active Schiff Base Polymers: Effects of Aromatic Linkage Geometry on Chiroptical Properties and Chemical Recyclability

10.1002/qua.70278.title: DFT / TDDFT Investigation of Excited-State Charge Transfer and Spectroscopic Properties in Nd@ C 82 Endohedral Metallofullerenes

10.1002/qute.70421.title: Polarization-Selective Transports in a Chiral Photon-Atom Coupled System

10.1002/rcm.70144.title: Integrated 1D-LC-HRMS and Heart-Cutting 2D-LC-MS for Impurity Profiling and Chiral Separation of Mitiglinide Drug Substance

10.1002/smll.74522.title: Surface Chirality Enables MtlA-Dependent Antibacterial Activity and Immune Remodeling by Gold Nanoparticles

10.1002/smll.74616.summary_japanese: クラウンエーテル支援自己集合とハロゲン制御により、発光色可変なキラルCu(I)ハライドクラスター2対を構築した。X線偏光光学系でS-BrとS-Iの解像度は各20、25 lp/mmへ向上した。

10.1002/smll.74684.title: Solvent-Free Preparation of Ti 3 C 2 T x Nanoscrolls for Enhanced Nonlinear Circular Dichroism

10.1002/smll.74704.title: Chiral-Ligand-Directed Synthesis of Circularly Polarized Luminescent Perovskite Nanowires

10.1002/smll.74841.title: Boosting Drug Permeability Across the Blood-Brain Barrier Through Supramolecular Macrocyclization

10.1002/smll.75074.title: Chiral Bifacial Indacenodithiophene-Based Hole-Transport Materials With Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity: Chirality-Spin Polarity Correspondence and Perovskite Passivation

Synergistic pi-pi stacking and C-H···O interactions stably encapsulated the substrates, enabling SCXRD structural elucidation of 13 glycosides and offline LC-SCXRD analysis of isoflavone glycosides directly from crude plant extracts.
10.1002/smll.75150.title: Crystalline Mate Assists Structural Elucidation and Offline LC-SCXRD Analysis of Flavonoid Glycosides via Synergistic pi-pi Stacking and C-H···O Interactions

10.1002/smll.75160.title: Connecting Nanoscale Molecular Self-Assembly to Macroscale Photophysical Property of Pyrene-Based Liquid Crystal Mesogen

10.1002/smll.75282.title: Crystallization-Driven Helical Conjugated Polymer Nanowires for Circularly Polarized Light-Addressable Ferroelectric Physical Unclonable Functions

10.1002/smll.75406.title: Tunable Chirality by Stacking Films of Magnetically Assembled Plasmonic Nanochains

10.1002/sscp.70297.title: Stereochemical Investigation of Paroxetine: Synthesis, Characterization, and Chiral High-Performance Liquid Chromatography Separation of All Four Stereoisomers

10.1007/s00253-026-13996-7.title: Enhanced biosynthesis of full-length triple-helical human type III collagen in engineered Komagataella phaffii

10.1007/s10493-026-01164-5.title: Synergistic action of piperonyl butoxide with macrocyclic lactones in Rhipicephalus microplus

10.1007/s11200-026-00027-4.title: The ECD-BIE Estimation Theorem in Spectral Form

10.1007/s11224-026-02858-7.title: Structure and conformational landscape of an unprecedented acyclic pentakis(cyclodiphosphazane)

10.1007/s40263-026-01317-5.title: PDE10A Inhibition in Schizophrenia: A Randomised, Placebo-Controlled Phase 2 Study of Alofropodect (CPL’36) in Patients Experiencing Acute Schizophrenia

10.1007/s42114-026-02032-x.title: Advances in applications of chiral biomaterials in bone regeneration

10.1007/s44245-026-00199-7.title: A novel approach for estimation of bending stiffness of helical strand assemblies and experimental validation

10.1016/j.aca.2026.346060.title: ENANTIOSELECTIVE LOW-PRESSURE GAS CHROMATOGRAPHY COMBINED WITH TRIPLE QUADRUPOLE MASS SPECTROMETRY FOR THE ANALYSIS OF 107 CHIRAL AND ACHIRAL PESTICIDE RESIDUES IN WINE

10.1016/j.afres.2026.102418.title: Quantification of natural raspberry flavor in foods using chiral GC-MS

10.1016/j.bbamem.2026.184561.title: Thermodynamic characterization of chirality effects in dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine bilayers

10.1016/j.compgeo.2026.108592.title: A nonlinear shaft-plate coupled load transfer model for axially loaded helical piles

10.1016/j.compstruct.2026.120759.summary_japanese: 5 kW fibreglass製helical vertical-axis wind turbine bladeを製作し、破壊試験とひずみ計測で性能を評価した。最大ひずみと破壊は前縁接着線の中央部・荷重点で生じ、複合材積層体でなく接着線が破壊した。
10.1016/j.compstruct.2026.120759.title: An analysis of the manufacturing and mechanical testing of a 5 kW helical vertical-axis wind turbine blade

10.1016/j.csite.2026.108363.summary_japanese: 偏心吸収管をもつ空気式ETSCで、helical coilとring turbulatorの熱流動性能を実験・RNG k-ε CFDで比較した。連続coilが優れ、4 mm coilは熱効率66%を達成し、CFDの出口温度誤差は約5%だった。
10.1016/j.csite.2026.108363.title: Experimental and CFD investigation of heat-transfer enhancement in eccentric evacuated-tube solar collectors using helical coils and ring turbulator inserts

10.1016/j.envpol.2026.128817.title: Chiral resolution of profoxydim: Implications for herbicidal efficacy and ecotoxicological assessment

10.1016/j.heliyon.2026.e45236.title: Three-dimensional finite element analysis of static compression tests on steel helical piles in clay and sand

10.1016/j.isci.2026.117379.title: Functional switching from circularly polarized luminescence to whispering gallery modes in a chiral Schiff base

10.1016/j.jcat.2026.117094.title: Enantioselective hydrogenation of hydroxyacetone on intrinsically chiral Pt(643) surfaces
